name: hud_ui_options_panel_texture_memory_init_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_TextureMemory::InitFromOptions reads the current hardware-mode texture-memory option and applies it to the cycle selector through SetIndexClamped.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40caf0 calls zOpt::GetTextureMemoryForCurrentHwMode, passes the result to HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::SetIndexClamped, and returns.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_texture_memory_init_from_options_smoke installs software and hardware TextureMemory option pointers, exercises both hardware-mode selectors, and verifies the selected cycle index follows SetIndexClamped including low and visible-range clamping.
